Vibrio cholerae uniquely possesses two circular chromosomes (chromosome I & II).
Assam + chronic cough + cavitary lung + caseating granulomas → consider histoplasmosis, a river-valley-endemic TB mimic.
Non-treponemal titres (VDRL/RPR) fall c̅ treatment, making them useful for monitoring disease response.
Diphtheria toxin ADP-ribosylates & inactivates elongation factor-2, halting host protein synthesis.
Catalase-positive GPC that's cefoxitin-sensitive = MSSA → cloxacillin is the drug of choice.
Poorly controlled diabetic c̅ facial pain & black nasal/palatal eschar → mucormycosis (Rhizopus).

Poly-D-glutamate capsule of B. anthracis is encoded on the pXO2 plasmid.
pXO1 instead encodes the toxin genes.
